name: Catholic Kitsch
summary: The aesthetic is a central part of "lived religion" for many Catholics, with its objects serving as tangible, everyday reminders of faith within the home and personal spaces.
description: The aesthetic is a central part of "lived religion" for many Catholics, with its objects serving as tangible, everyday reminders of faith within the home and personal spaces. It is an amalgam of the religious and the secular, often blending sacred iconography with the materials and styles of popular commercial culture. [ 2 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Devotion, nostalgia, accessibility, sentimentality, "lived religion"
